items.title: Apollo to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 3, 2026
items.takeaway: In a press release: Apollo to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 3, 2026.
items.whyItMatters: Apollo is a private-credit heavyweight whose insurance arm, Athene, supplies long-term capital, which makes it central to the fusion of insurance and private lending. Developments in private markets show how capital is being raised, deployed and returned outside public exchanges. For allocators: private-market commitments tie up capital for years, so pacing and manager selection drive outcomes.
items.marketContext: The 10-year Treasury yield is 5.24% (up 7 bps on the prior reading) and high-yield credit spreads are 3.02%, near long-run norms (up 9 bps on the prior reading). Open debt markets make leveraged deals easier to finance and support valuations. (FRED data as of Sep 29.)

beginnerNote.explanation: The investors in a private fund, such as pensions, endowments, insurers and family offices. They commit capital but do not manage the fund.

items.title: Goldman’s $18.2bn private credit fund sees redemption requests fall to 2%
items.takeaway: Goldman Sachs’ $18.2bn private credit fund recorded another decline in investor redemption requests during the third quarter, bucking the elevated withdrawal levels reported across much of the private credit market, according to a report by Reuters.
items.whyItMatters: Goldman Sachs is a top global investment bank and growing alternatives manager, with a front-row view of deal, capital-markets and client flows. Developments here show how easily companies can borrow outside the banking system, and at what price. For allocators: private credit offers high floating-rate income but less liquidity, so manager selection and underwriting discipline matter.
items.marketContext: The effective fed funds rate is 3.88% and high-yield credit spreads are 3.02%, near long-run norms (up 9 bps on the prior reading). Most private loans pay a floating rate, so lender income tracks short-term rates while spreads show how much extra investors demand for credit risk. (FRED data as of Sep 29.)

beginnerNote.explanation: Loans made by investment funds rather than banks, usually to mid-sized companies. They often pay higher, floating interest rates.

items.title: Bain Capital weighs $15bn-plus Edged deal in US data centre push
items.takeaway: Bain Capital is among the private equity firms bidding for Edged, the US data centre developer and operator owned by Koch, in a transaction that could value the business at more than $15bn, according to a report by Bloomberg.
items.whyItMatters: Bain Capital is a major private-equity and credit investor whose deals are a read on sponsor appetite in its sectors. Demand for power, data centers and energy transition projects is pulling record private capital into infrastructure. For allocators: infrastructure can diversify a portfolio, but deal sizes are large and access often runs through the biggest managers.
items.marketContext: The 10-year Treasury yield is 5.24% (up 7 bps on the prior reading) and the effective fed funds rate is 3.88%. Long-lived assets such as infrastructure, insurance portfolios and annuities are priced off these yields. (FRED data as of Sep 29.)

beginnerNote.explanation: A fund that owns essential physical assets such as power, pipelines, data centers, airports and fiber, which usually produce steady, long-term cash flows.

items.title: Warburg Pincus hits $12bn of exits in 2026
items.takeaway: Warburg Pincus has realised around $12bn from investment exits so far this year, matching the record amount returned by the private equity firm across the whole of 2025, according to a report by Reuters.
items.whyItMatters: Warburg Pincus is a veteran growth-equity investor, a useful read on growth-stage private valuations. The pace of exits determines when investors get cash back and how much they can recommit to new funds. For allocators: distributions (DPI) are the ultimate scorecard, because paper gains only count once they turn into cash.
